sentences.text:
Ms. Pinaki Dutta, Adv.
Ms. Munmun Tiwary, Adv.
Ms. Chumki Chowdhuri, Adv.
Ms. Jayashree Saha, Adv.
...for the petitioner.

Though charge-sheet has been filed against the petitioner under Sections 498A/509/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, it is submitted by the learned Advocate for the petitioner that by virtue of a Memorandum of Understanding, both the petitioner and his wife, opposite party No.2 have settled all their disputes amicably.
Therefore, he has prayed for quashing of the above-mentioned criminal proceeding.

Petitioner is directed to serve notice upon the private opposite party No.2 under registered speed post with acknowledgment due and file affidavit of service within three weeks from the date of this order.
The State of West Bengal be served through the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta.
In the meantime, further proceeding in respect of G.R. Case No.368 of 2021 be stayed for a period of six weeks.

( Bibek Chaudhuri, J. )
